header-nav: Symbol 24px · mono index · status capsule right (Signal dot = accepting work, G3 = booked). Collapses to 48px bar on scroll; never a hamburger on desktop.
mobile-nav: Full-screen ink plate folds down (T_PAGE), not a side drawer; fold direction matches the mark.
section-number: Numbered-section architecture 00–08; numeral in Archivo 850, register line in mono. Never recoloured.
instrument-rail: Right-edge column minus 40px; carries coordinates, clock, section index. Mirrors left in RTL.
metadata-row: Mono caps, middle dots + em dashes, never pipes. 55–70% ink.
project-index-row: Register format: index / title / discipline / year. Filters = 8 discipline chips, outline rest, filled active.
project-card: Plate + mono metadata + Expanded title + one-line claim (provable assertion). No shadows, ever.
project-card-hover: Plane lifts 2px, corner cuts 42°, Signal OPEN chip appears. On touch: press state.
button-primary: Rectangle, radius 2px, mono 10px caps +12%. Verbs with objects.
button-destructive: Keyline + Signal label; confirmed by typed word — no red modal floods.
cta-pair: Hero offers exactly two actions, different verbs. One CTA per view wins; two maximum.
link: Dash underline fills left→right in 120ms. Links at rest never Signal.
form-input: Underline fields on ink plates, hairline on paper; validation inline mono + dash marker in Signal; success prints like terminal output.
status: Live dot pulses while accepting work (state has a reason); G3 when booked.
loading-state: Direction B: capsules fill left→right while a mono readout reports state. Reduced motion: static 42% fill.
error-state: Errors are states with recovery paths, never aesthetics. Ink plate + mono + one action.
empty-state: Dash field + honest sentence. Never an illustration mascot.
media-frame: 1.5px keyline plate, 0 offset; metadata strip carries index / subject / lens. Images: threshold mono, fold-crop edges.
case-plate-01: Fixed five-plate anatomy; depth comparable across projects.
case-plate-02: Fixed five-plate anatomy; depth comparable across projects.
case-plate-03: Fixed five-plate anatomy; depth comparable across projects.
case-plate-04: Fixed five-plate anatomy; depth comparable across projects.
case-plate-05: Fixed five-plate anatomy; depth comparable across projects; Signal-indexed — the differentiator.
footer: Claim line + three-beat dash + coordinates + legal mono. Scroll progress = dash filling in the rail.
product-endorsement: Products keep their own name, inherit keyline + type, carry “a HABIBCORE system” + master footer. No product logos, no sub-brands.
